Name: Utility Bags for the Item Bags mod
Author: AtlasV1224
Description:
[center][img]https://atlasv.info/images/SDVModding/overview.png[/img]﻿

These are some simple new utility bags for the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bags[/url]﻿ mod﻿.
More bags are planned in the future.

Bags for catEgories of items for specific mods won't be included here,
however once I learn more about how these bagswork there will be utility bags for specific mods.
(Right now vanilla and all mods are supported in the bags which may lead to crowding in large packs)



[img]https://atlasv.info/images/SDVModding/information.png[/img]
Currently there are 3 categories of bags:

[u]Colour Bags:
[/u]These store different items in colour catagories for use with dyeing or quests
The colours available right now are Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Black, and White

[u]Dynamic Bags:
[/u]These bags dynamically update what they can store depending on different conditions:
Museum Bag: Stores 1 of every item that needs to be donated to the museum, updates when you leave the museum or sleep

[u]Meme/Funny Bags:
[/u]Tortilla Bag: Stores all the tortillas you can eat! (up to 9999 at once)



[img]https://atlasv.info/images/SDVModding/installation.png[/img]﻿

To Install all you need to do is:
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bags[/url]﻿ and it's dependancies
Download and open the file from this nexus page
Place the JSON files into the ItemBags > assets > Modded Bags folder

That's it!
[/center]
